description: HPO phenotype frequencies for FARIMPD and published case tally
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests

r = requests.get("https://ontology.jax.org/api/network/annotation/OMIM:619602", timeout=60).json()
rows=[]
for cat, items in r["categories"].items():
    for it in items:
        f = it["metadata"].get("frequency","")
        if "/" in f:
            n, d = [int(x) for x in f.split("/")]
            rows.append({"cat":cat,"hpo":it["id"],"term":it["name"],"n":n,"d":d,"pct":n/d*100})
H = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("pct")

cases = pd.DataFrame([
 {"report":"Chatron 2019","families":2,"cases":4},
 {"report":"Monteiro 2020","families":2,"cases":3},
 {"report":"Furukawa 2024","families":1,"cases":1},
])

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 4.6), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.7,1]})
cols = {"Nervous System":"#C44E52","Prenatal and Birth":"#4C72B0","Clinical course":"#55A868",
        "Head and neck":"#8172B2","Connective tissue":"#CCB974"}
ax = axes[0]
ax.barh(range(len(H)), H["pct"], color=[cols.get(c,"#999999") for c in H["cat"]])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(H)))
ax.set_yticklabels([t+"  ("+h+")" for t,h in zip(H["term"],H["hpo"])], fontsize=9)
for i,(p,n,d) in enumerate(zip(H["pct"],H["n"],H["d"])):
    ax.text(p+1.5, i, str(n)+"/"+str(d), va="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,122); ax.set_xlabel("frequency among annotated patients (%)")
ax.set_title("HPO annotations for OMIM:619602 / MONDO:0859204\nsource PMID 31608932")

ax = axes[1]
ax.bar(cases["report"], cases["cases"], color=["#C44E52","#C44E52","#4C72B0"])
for i,(c,f) in enumerate(zip(cases["cases"],cases["families"])):
    ax.text(i, c+0.08, str(c)+" cases\n"+str(f)+" families", ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("reported patients"); ax.set_ylim(0,5.4)
ax.set_title("All published FARIMPD patients: 8 from 5 families")
plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=15, ha="right", fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(H.to_string(index=False))
